name: Murder at the Manor
description: A guest lies dead at the manor. Each suspect was in a different room with a different motive. Work out whodunit.
clues: Cleaver goes with exactly two of Grimsby, Secrecy, and Cooking.
Dagger goes with exactly one of Revenge, Spite, or Sleeping.

Reading goes with Secrecy if and only if either Cleaver does not go with Ashford or Secrecy does not go with Holloway (but not both).
